records.title: CMSL: Constructive Multi-Sequence Learning for Recommendation Systems
records.reason: Primary abstract reviewed: Sequence learning has emerged as the promising paradigm in recommendation systems, surpassing traditional Deep Learning Recommendation Models (DLRM) by capturing the temporal nuances of user behavior. However, current state-of-the-art architectures operate under a limiting analogy: they treat user history as a monolithic chronological sequence like a sentence in a Large Language Model (LLM). We observe a fundamental … Out of scope: Recommendation-system sequence modeling.

records.title: Depth-Staggered Fibonacci Spacing for Sparse Attention: Static Schedules Beat Learned Dilation and Extrapolate Where Dense Attention Fails
records.reason: Although sparse attention is an inference-relevant mechanism, the direct efficiency evidence is negative for the learned variant and the main static result is a small-model quality/extrapolation study without serving-latency gains.

records.title: Let the Data Decide: Supervision Analysis, Capability Trade-offs, and Adaptive Objective Routing in Continued Pre-Training via Off-Policy Distillation
records.reason: Primary abstract reviewed: Off-policy distillation is now central to large language model pre-training, yet how training data, objective parameterization, and model capabilities interact remains poorly characterized. records.title: AdaThinking-E: One-Token Entropy Regulation for Adaptive Thinking
records.reason: Adaptive token reduction is an indirect efficiency signal in a narrow multimodal document-reasoning setting; no serving latency/throughput or broad workload evidence is shown.

records.title: Position Is All You Need: A Free Lunch Token Compression Strategy for MLLM-based Referring Expression Segmentation
